name: Arimathea
overview: Arimathea, also called Ramah, was a town located about five miles north of Jerusalem. It is notably associated with Joseph of Arimathea, a rich and honorable man who was a disciple of Jesus and awaited the kingdom of God. Scripture highlights his courageous act of requesting Jesus' body from Pilate after the crucifixion, demonstrating his devotion and respect for Christ despite fear of the Jewish authorities.
